End-member ThO2 (Strem 99.99%); conventional cell contains Th4O8. Distinct phase, not a multiphase aggregate. Structure and EOS provenance are separate.

## Chidester et al. (2018), thorianite experimental thermal EOS

`thorianite_chidester_2018_bm3_linear_thermal` · Executable

Reproduction: **reproduced** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/thorianite.md#record-thorianite_chidester_2018_bm3_linear_thermal)

**Source check:** Coefficients from Table 1 (p. 750) and Equations 1-3 (p. 754), where alpha\_KT is a constant alpha\*K\_T product; the printed V0 = 26.379 cm³/mol is stored per Z = 4 cell. Other Table 1 rows are literature comparisons.

- **Record kind:** published
- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Equation kind:** thermal
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Chidester; Pardo; Fischer; Thompson; Heinz; Prescher; Prakapenka; Campbell
    - **Year:** 2018
    - **Title:** High-pressure phase behavior and equations of state of ThO2 polymorphs
    - **Source:** American Mineralogist 103, 749–756
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am-2018-6212
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0, 28\]

- **Reported temperature coverage (K):** \[300, 2135\]

Fitted to the 300 K data below 15 GPa plus all high-temperature data; the anomalous room-temperature points at higher pressure are excluded. V0 is fixed at its measured value; published errors have unspecified confidence. Phase coexistence and kinetic inhibition occur in the experiments.
